channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Starbucks' Unicorn Frappuccino makes a magical return for one weekend only
item.description: The Unicorn Frappuccino blended beverage will return to coffeehouses around the world to close out the summer starting August 15.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Video shows aftermath of non-combat military crash; pilot walks away after ejecting
item.description: Newly released video shows the moments before and after a Marine Corps F/A-18 Hornet crashed into a Washington mountainside. The pilot ejected safely and called 911 after the crash.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] An 'influencer' degree? Colleges launch content creation majors
item.description: Ask a teen what they want to be when they grow up, and there's a fair chance being an influencer is on their list.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Army staff sergeant’s wife brought back to US after mid-flight ICE reversal
item.description: After a mystery phone call mid-flight, ICE removed a soldier’s wife from a deportation plane to Brazil and returned her home to Louisiana.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Thousands of soup kits recalled due to potential Listeria contamination
item.description: The FDA has announced a recall for a Marketside Tomato Bisque Soup Kit that has been sold at Walmart stores around the country.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] North Manatee Soccer Club allegedly loses over $146K to former treasurer’s personal expenses
item.description: A former North Manatee Soccer Club treasurer faces a felony charge after investigators found she allegedly stole over $146,000 in club funds for personal expenses, according to the sheriff's office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk County saw palmetto berry poacher picked up on university property: PCSO
item.description: Deputies arrested Rodney Michael after security officers found his pickup truck loaded with illegally harvested saw palmetto berries hidden on Warner University property.
